category: economic and shipping data API (macro time series, ports, vessels)

free_tier.stated: No free API: the website allows 15 free views a day; the USD 400 a year subscription includes CSV downloads and API access
free_tier.notes: The API docs (released 29 July 2025) require a token in the Authorization header. Keyless calls to both the legacy series endpoint and the v1 ports endpoint answered HTTP 401. Whether a free account can mint a token is unverified: behind a sign-up.

retention.notes: Port calls, congestion, dwell and throughput are available from 2022 onwards.

egress.terms: not metered in bytes; no request quota is stated

interface_detail: GET https://api.econdb.com/v1/... with Authorization: Token KEY
tooling: curl or any HTTP client; Python and R clients are published
chaining: Macro series and port data need a paid token here; FRED and Fiscal Data give macro series with a free key or none.

limits.value: API access is part of the USD 400 a year subscription; keyless calls answer 401

limits_note: Bulk path: CSV downloads are part of the subscription; Enterprise offers bulk files and feeds. Storage terms: unverified, the terms page answered HTTP 404.
binding_note: A paid subscription, not a request count, stands between a caller and the API.

identity_cost.detail: The account form takes an optional email, a username and a password, or Google sign-in; no card on the form. The paid API needs a payment.

reliability_note: Keyless calls answer HTTP 401 Authentication credentials were not provided.
confidence_note: Plan and API terms are read from the vendor pages; two keyless probes answered 401; the free account's token rights were not read.
